# Compliance Register

**As of:** 2026-11-27 · **Items:** 61 · **Source:** `docs/compliance/register.json` (this file and the CSV are generated by `scripts/build-compliance-register.ts`; do not edit them by hand).

**Assumptions:** Operator established in Poland (pricing in PLN); adult learners (18+); consumers and professional buyers; EU and international sales; AI via third-party providers (planned, Phase 4); payments via Stripe (planned, Stage 7); hosting on Vercel and Supabase (planned). To be confirmed by the Academy.

> **How to read this register.** *Nature* separates technical controls, which are implemented and verified by automated tests, from legal, documentary and organisational requirements, which need decisions or professional verification. A technical control marked Compliant does not make the Academy legally compliant: **the Academy must not be described as legally compliant until the external specialists named in this register have reviewed the applicable requirements.**

> This register records the Academy's own assessment. It is not legal advice. A status of “Compliant” means that the control is implemented and that evidence is recorded here; it does not mean that a lawyer has confirmed compliance. Items marked “Requires legal review” or with external review “Yes” must be reviewed by a qualified lawyer, data-protection specialist or tax adviser before launch.

### AI Act

#### AI-01 · Prohibition of emotion recognition in education (AI must not infer learners' emotions)

| Field | Entry |
|---|---|
| Source | EU AI Act Art. 5(1)(f); applicable since 2 Feb 2025 |
| Type | Legally mandatory |
| Applicability | Yes (design constraint for Phase 4) |
| Nature | Technical + legal |
| **Status** | **Compliant — verified with evidence** |
| Evidence | Code review 26 Nov 2026: no AI, camera or voice analysis exists in the platform; approved design limits feedback to observable communication behaviours; requirement written into AI governance requirements (AUDIT_REPORT §3) |
| Gaps | Must be enforced in AI prompts, features and vendor selection (no 'nervousness' or 'confidence' detection from face or voice) |
| Responsible role | Academic Director / technical lead |
| Corrective action | Include in Phase 4 acceptance criteria and test cases |
| External review needed | Yes — confirm interpretation of 'education institution' |
